description: Change event 'policy_changed'. Published when a runtime policy is created, changed, or deleted with a reason (PRD cpt-cf-approval-service-fr-approval-policies), and for each configuration-file policy added, changed, or removed when the service starts with a changed configuration digest (PRD cpt-cf-approval-service-fr-event-notifications). In p1 policies are live: affected open requests are reconciled after commit, and closures publish request_closed naming this change. Derived from the Event Broker base event type; routed to the approval_events topic and partitioned by subject for per-entity ordering.

type.$comment: Pins the event-type identifier so an editor can validate a payload against this schema alone.

policy_id.description: The policy (also the event subject): a UUID for runtime policys, the stable synthetic identifier for configuration policys.

layer.description: Layer of the changed policy. Enum evolution: new layers only in a new major.

change.description: Kind of change. Enum evolution: new kinds only in a new major.

affected.description: Patterns before and after the change (one entry for create or delete, up to two for update), so consumers can invalidate every verdict the change can affect.

resource_selector.description: Resource selector: exactly one of a projection type pattern or one specific projection.

reason.description: Change reason: mandatory caller reason for runtime changes; for configuration changes, a service text naming the old and new configuration digests.

verdict_version.description: Monotonic version of the committed change (the change sequence). Verdicts computed after this change carry a version greater than or equal to it.

dedup_key.description: Deterministic deduplication key (UUIDv5 over change sequence, event type, entity, and target tenant). Delivery is at least once; consumers deduplicate by this key (PRD cpt-cf-approval-service-fr-event-notifications).

changed_by.description: Authenticated identity whose call caused the change. Absent when the service caused it (reconciliation, expiry sweep).
